Calculate per-cell coverage and MAPD from a tile count matrix

Source: R/cell_qc.R
calculate_mapd.Rd

Compute per-cell coverage, MAPD (median absolute pairwise difference) and scaled MAPD from a tile-by-cell count matrix.

Usage

calculate_mapd(
  tile_matrix,
  genome_granges,
  meta_data,
  aggr_bins = 50,
  verbose = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

tile_matrix

A tile-by-cell count matrix (base or Matrix sparse matrix) with row names equal to names(genome_granges) and column names equal to rownames(meta_data), in the same order.

genome_granges

A named GRanges with one range per row of tile_matrix and metadata columns gc_frequency, mappability and is_mappable (see compute_bin_mappability()).

meta_data

A data.frame of cell metadata, row names = cell IDs.

aggr_bins

Positive integer; number of consecutive tiles aggregated before computing MAPD. We use 50.

verbose

Logical; print progress messages. Default FALSE.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam; cells are processed in chunks in parallel. Results do not depend on the number of workers.

Value

meta_data with added or updated columns coverage, mapd, scaled_mapd (numeric) and mapd_error (character, NA when the cell succeeded).

Details

Steps:

  1. A per-tile GC correction value is computed from the pseudo-bulk (row sums): tiles are grouped by round(gc_frequency, 1), and the value is median(all reads/mappability) / median(group reads/mappability). Only mappable tiles with finite GC, positive mappability and finite correction are used further.

  2. For each cell, corrected reads are reads / mappability * gc_corr; coverage = 1e6 * sum(corrected) / effective genome size (sum of the widths of the used tiles).

  3. Corrected reads are summed in groups of aggr_bins consecutive used tiles per chromosome; MAPD is the median absolute deviation (around the median, unscaled) of the differences between adjacent groups on the same chromosome, and scaled_mapd = round(mapd / sqrt(coverage), 3).

Examples

set.seed(1)
gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(seq(1, by = 1000, length.out = 200),
                                                      width = 1000))
names(gr) <- paste0("bin", seq_along(gr))
gr$gc_frequency <- runif(200, 0.35, 0.5)
gr$mappability <- 1
gr$is_mappable <- TRUE
m <- matrix(rpois(200 * 5, 5), 200, 5, dimnames = list(names(gr), paste0("c", 1:5)))
m <- Matrix::Matrix(m, sparse = TRUE)
md <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(m), cell_id = colnames(m))
calculate_mapd(m, gr, md, aggr_bins = 10, verbose = FALSE)
#>    cell_id coverage      mapd scaled_mapd mapd_error
#> c1      c1 4967.292  6.250000       0.089       <NA>
#> c2      c2 5207.500  6.500000       0.090       <NA>
#> c3      c3 5125.000  3.708333       0.052       <NA>
#> c4      c4 5006.042 10.083333       0.143       <NA>
#> c5      c5 4924.167  5.500000       0.078       <NA>
